title: Forrestal's limo ride with Symington and 'You are a loyal fellow'

tellings.quote: in his chair. He's just staring ahead at like this blank wall and he's repeating one sentence. What is it? You are a loyal fellow.

plain: In 1949, after a limousine ride with the official Steuart Simington, James Forrestal, then Secretary of Defense under Harry Truman, is said to have sat in his office chair staring at a blank wall and repeating one sentence: "You are a loyal fellow." The researcher Richard Dolan tells Michels this without naming a source, as part of his account of a defense secretary whose breakdown and death he ties to UFO secrets.
